prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='DWT_rf', recommended_method='topk_mean_per_horizon'. Narrative: DWT_rf dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and near-perfect seasonal correlation (0.9999), achieving the lowest RMSE of 0.1442. The extremely high RMSE spread ratio (468.8571) indicates massive model disagreement, suggesting combination methods are more robust than single-model selection. FT_rf excels at early horizons (0.0624 RMSE) while DWT_rf dominates late horizons (0.1472 RMSE), supporting per-horizon selection via topk_mean_per_horizon with mixed weighting to leverage both trend and seasonal strengths.
